$comment: Repos that ship this CLI to someone. Declared here because nothing else knows.
Each of these pins a commit of this repo. When main moves, every pin is silently
stale until a person happens to look — which is how ideaspaces-plugin sat 6 commits
behind and pi-is-space 7, both carrying a commit verb that would save a file the
user was promised would stay local. Neither repo was broken. Nothing asked.
`tracked: false` means a consumer maintains its own bump flow. It is still listed:
the point of this file is that the set is knowable, not that we drive all of it.

consumers.note: Ships cli/bundle/ideaspaces.js to Claude Code users. Bump via `npm run vendor` there, then a version bump — Claude Code keys its install cache by plugin version.
Shells the CLI's commit verb from src/index.ts — both the --all and explicit-path shapes — so a stale pin means the other agent surface behaves differently from Claude Code's.

Bumped on the desktop app's own flow, which runs its own checks. Listed so the set is complete, not to be driven from here. It also depends on pi-is-space, so it can resolve two CLI builds at once — worth knowing when a behaviour differs between its sidecars.
